one_liner_zh: Adobe 上季 EPS 6.06 美元超預期 3.18%，營收 64 億美元，訂閱與 AI 升級延續穩定動能。
one_liner_en: Adobe beat EPS at $6.06 by 3.18% on $6.40B revenue, with subscriptions and AI upgrades sustaining steady momentum.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 超預期 3.18%，獲利穩健（營收年增率未提供）。
ai_view_zh: 訊號中性偏正：EPS 連續超預期顯示獲利穩健，但低本益比反映市場對 AI 顛覆與成長放緩的疑慮尚未消除。短期股價料隨大盤與軟體情緒波動。中期應追蹤 AI 變現進度、ARR 成長與淨新增訂閱，若管理層能證明 Firefly 帶來增量營收，估值有上修空間，反之則維持折價。
ai_view_en: Signal is mildly positive: a repeat EPS beat shows steady profitability, but the low P/E indicates lingering concern over AI disruption and slowing growth. Near term the stock should track broad software sentiment. Mid term, watch AI monetization progress, ARR growth and net-new subscriptions; if management proves Firefly adds incremental revenue, there is upside to the multiple, otherwise the discount persists.
highlights_zh: EPS 6.06 美元，超預期 3.18%，獲利動能延續
營收 64.0 億美元，規模穩定擴張
Creative 與 Document Cloud 訂閱表現穩健
本益比約 11.92 倍，估值相對保守
highlights_en: EPS of $6.06 beat by 3.18%, sustaining earnings momentum
Revenue of $6.40B with steady scale expansion
Creative and Document Cloud subscriptions remain solid
P/E of ~11.92x reflects a conservative valuation
risks_zh: 生成式 AI 競爭加劇，創作工具護城河受檢驗
本期未提供營收年增率，成長能見度有限
企業 IT 預算趨保守恐影響企業端擴張
risks_en: Rising genAI competition tests the moat of creative tools
Revenue YoY not provided, limiting growth visibility
Cautious enterprise IT budgets may slow enterprise expansion
